profile: Native markers, UTF-8, standard-conforming strings, sensitive decoded namespace names.
scope: An ordered DROP SCHEMA selector over exact declared local namespaces. Preserve existence and dependency policies and repeated selectors.

SchemaDropTarget.role: One absolute local namespace selector with its resolved presence.
SchemaDropTarget.structure: A checked PostgreSQL Identifier and a readonly presence Boolean.
invariants: A native application or known stock namespace has one decoded name.
The session alias pg_temp and backend-numbered temporary namespaces need explicit session-specific interpretation.
An absent selector is admitted only in the owning guarded operation.
SchemaDropTarget.meaning: Resolve the selected namespace in the same external database. An absent guarded selector still contributes its native skip notice.

DropSchema.structure: A nonempty detached ordered list of SchemaDropTarget values, both independent policy bits and the fixed grammar release.
invariants: All entries are completed typed namespace selectors.
Retain the supplied sequence, including repeated selectors.
DropSchema.meaning: Drop the resolved namespaces with RESTRICT or CASCADE. Native dependency edges determine whether removal fails or propagates to other objects.
DropSchema.sql: Safely delimit every namespace, preserve its position, and emit both policy choices.

binding: A known namespace can be introduced by an explicit schema or by a checked relation declaration. Resolve names independently of the relation search path.
Retain exact case and spelling. A schema selector has one component even when its decoded identifier contains dots.
Require a complete namespace catalog before inferring absence. Require IF EXISTS when a selector is absent.
Relation dependency graph, privilege and transaction effects are interpreted in the same external catalog.

finite.bound: Every one of the 48 admissible ordered selector and policy coordinates per release. Compare both direct and analyzed routes. The 8 unguarded absent coordinates are checked as typed rejections.

exploration.structure: Vary selector list length, repeats, present and absent operands, quoted names, foreign-key and view dependents, and transaction mode.

observations: Exact typed namespace selector order, decoded names and guard bits.
Native command status, SQLSTATE and ordered missing namespace notices, including repeated notices for repeated missing names.
Namespace presence, contained relations and row values, surviving views, surviving foreign keys, and rollback or atomic failure effects.
negative: One absent selector without IF EXISTS in each of the eight unguarded absent finite coordinates
An inferred absent selector in an incomplete context
A session alias without a declared numbered physical namespace
faults: Resolve or render a different namespace with a similarly shaped relation
Replace the dependency mode with RESTRICT
Lose a guardable missing selector occurrence
trust: Exact constructor, context visibility and rendering path checks
Native dependency, transactional rollback and warning behavior under the pinned releases
open: Declared backend-specific temporary schema roles and permission-changing execution environments.
